headline: Good observation. The warhead of the Haj Qassem ballistic missile used during the recent operations differs from previous versions. The original Haj Qassem featured a bi-conical (double-cone) warhead (shown in the second image), while the new version has a single-cone warhead (shown in the first image), similar to that of the Kheibar Shekan-2. Another notable difference is an additional section between the warhead and the missile's solid-fuel booster, which is likely an adapter section.
